subject: Actuating the arrange area's region selection over AX
question: Is there an actuator on the arrange surface that SETS the region selection to one chosen region?

reverify.command: swiftc a probe that walks the arrange window for AXLayoutItem elements whose AXHelp names a region, then: (1) from an emptied selection write AXSelected=true to ONE region three times, printing the whole selection vector after each write; (2) perform AXPress on a region from a 2-selected and from a 0-selected state; (3) read AXSelectedChildren settability on the enclosing AXLayoutArea; (4) click 편집 > 선택 > 전체 선택 해제 and re-read the vector.
reverify.expected: the three writes give selected, DESELECTED, selected; AXPress leaves nothing selected from either start and returns success; AXSelectedChildren is settable=false; the menu item empties the selection
reverify.cost: ~3 min, any project with two or more regions

method: Asked what the actuators DO rather than what they return, because on this surface the return code is uninformative — every write and every action below reported success. Each candidate was driven from a pre-state that had been read back, and the whole selection vector was printed after each step, so an effect on a region other than the target could not hide. The decisive control was writing the SAME value to the SAME region repeatedly: a setter is idempotent and a toggle is not, and nothing else distinguishes them from a single write.

observations.what: AXSelected = true, written three times to one region from an emptied selection
AXSelected = true, single write to an unselected region while another was selected
observations.reading: indistinguishable from 'adds' on one write — this is the observation the repository's earlier note generalised from

observations.what: Logic's own 편집 > 선택 > 전체 선택 해제
the composition — Deselect All, then one AXSelected write
AXIdentifier as a locale-free way to name the menu item
observations.shared_identifier_note: 10 of the 17 items in the Select submenu share the single value localMenuItemAction:, which names the dispatcher rather than the item

observations.what: the product's region.select_last driven live after the fix
observations.pre_state: one region selected, and NOT the last one
observations.independent_recheck: exactly 1 selected and it is a different region than before
observations.repeat_results: State A, count 1, same track index each time

conclusion: No single actuator on this surface sets the region selection. AXSelected is settable and returns success and is a toggle — 3 writes of the same value give selected, deselected, selected. AXPress returns success and never selects, from either a 2-selected or a 0-selected start. The enclosing AXLayoutArea publishes AXSelectedChildren but reports it settable=false. A toggle is still usable from a pre-state that has been established and READ BACK, and Logic's own Deselect All establishes one: 2 selected -> 0, then one write -> exactly 1. Driven live, region.select_last moved the selection off a non-last region onto the last one and reported State A with a count of 1, and 3 further runs from the already-correct state stayed State A with count 1 — which a toggle without the clear could not do. The menu item is reachable without a localized label because its AXIdentifier deselectAll: is unique among the Edit menu's 151 items; that is not a general escape from localization, since 12 of 12 menu-bar items publish no identifier and 10 of 17 items in one submenu share localMenuItemAction:.
limits: One host, one locale, one Logic build. Whether the toggle is 12.3 behaviour or older was not established.
Measured with 2 regions on one project. A selection spanning many tracks was not driven, and the historical 18-region note it explains was not re-run.
The AXIdentifier census covers the Edit menu only. Other menus were not scanned beyond their menu-bar items.

region.select_last is routed and handled but is not registered in any dispatcher, so this operation cannot currently be reached from the MCP tool surface. It was driven through a temporary executable target linking the library, not through a shipped call path.
enumerateRegionItems drops regions outside the visible arrange area, so every count here is over visible regions.
